rothe_curator.text: Rothe House was built by a merchant, John Rothe Fitz Piers, between 1594 and 1610. Three houses, three courtyards and a long garden.
The garden is a Tudor plot, with herbs, vegetables and an orchard. In those days townsfolk grew most of their own dinner.
It is one of the best Tudor merchant houses left in Ireland, which is a lot of 'best' for one building.

then.text: Declan, steward of Rothe House. Yes, I wrote to Nuala. Yes, I would love the pot. It is the finest piece of dubious provenance in the county.
But I was here Tuesday night for the Tudor Garden evening. Sixty guests, one orchard, a lot of cider. Check the visitors' book, over by the shelf.

else.text: Lovely old building, this. Ask me again if you ever hear there's trouble.
